decision_reason: C-DEC-002 is a Rust-local pure/core invariant on `decode_slot_written_extra`; the rust_local + pure_core risk_tags map to Verus as primary per references/risk-taxonomy.md universal profile. Verus proves the discriminator body holds for ALL bytes (no length bound), which is the strongest possible claim and is the canonical fix verification for the actual P1 bug.

C-DEC-002 is the rejection claim for the magic-but-unknown-version branch; the bounded_state + rejection risk_tags map to Kani as primary per references/verifier-trigger-matrix.md. Kani provides bounded symbolic evidence with explicit `len <= 256` and an exact `kani::assert` on the VersionMismatch output. Kani is the companion to Verus (which proves for-all): Kani bounds the input space; Verus proves the unbounded invariant.

C-DEC-004 (three-arm partition: mutually exclusive + exhaustive) is a bounded_state claim; Kani proves the partition holds for `len in [0, 256]` and proves each arm is reachable via paired `kani::cover!` and exact `kani::assert` on the classification. The same harness also captures the C-NEG-006 zero-allocation reachability for the legacy arm.

C-CON-001 (prefix compositionally derived from MAGIC+VERSION) and C-CON-004 (prefix length = MAGIC.len() + 1 = 5) are refinement claims about public constants; the refinement + index risk_tags map to Flux-RS as primary per references/risk-taxonomy.md. Flux-RS proves the prefix-length relationship at the type level and prevents MAGIC-vs-PREFIX drift.

C-DEC-002 is the rejection claim for the unknown-version branch; the property + parser + codec risk_tags map to Proptest as primary companion per references/verifier-trigger-matrix.md. Proptest provides randomized property pressure with a non-vacuous `MagicKnown + VersionUnknown` strategy and an explicit anti-invariant (`assert!(result != Ok(LegacyFrameExtra(_)))`). The user-explicit lane instruction includes proptest as a required lane.

C-ENC-002 (encode→decode round-trip) is an equality claim over a strategy-generated input space; the property + equality + codec risk_tags map to Proptest as primary per references/defense-depth-matrix.md equality row. Proptest's `Taint` (4-variant enum) × `Option<Vec<u8>>` (bounded length) strategy covers all 4 × arbitrary frame_extra combinations, and the harness asserts the exact decoded envelope value, not just `is_ok()`. The same harness captures the C-NEG-001/002/003 anti-invariants (legacy short, magic-only 4-byte, corrupt v1).

C-REC-002 and C-RUN-002 are the hydrate/collect translation sites; the user-visible-behavior + observability + api risk_tags require a property test that exercises the full translation chain (storage codec → recovery/collect error lattice → tracing log emission). Proptest is the only lane in the user-bounded four-lane set that can drive behavior assertions across both crates plus log capture; Verus/Kani/Flux are scoped to the per-symbol boundary. The harness asserts both the returned error variant AND the captured `tracing::warn!` event content (slot, found for hydrate; slot, seq, found for collect).
